scenes.text: The first computer bug was a real bug.
In September nineteen forty seven, the Harvard Mark Two computer kept making errors.
Engineers opened it up and found a moth stuck inside a relay.
They taped it into the logbook with a note: first actual case of bug being found.
That page, moth and all, is now kept at the Smithsonian.
What is the weirdest bug your phone or computer ever had?

title: The first computer bug was a REAL bug 🦋
caption: On Sept 9, 1947, engineers on the Harvard Mark II found a moth trapped in a relay and taped it into their logbook. The page is now at the Smithsonian.
